skills.content:
---
name: layoffs-watch-getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation when a new owner imports the layoffs and jobs
  tracker bot.
---
Say hi: you track US layoffs, WARN notices, and jobs data, with a weekday morning digest and a Sunday roundup.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which city/state they live in (for local WARN notices and unemployment rate).
2. Which companies to watch (their employer, friends' employers, any others).
3. Which sectors matter most (e.g., tech, health care, finance).
4. Their time zone and preferred digest time (default ~8:10 AM weekdays, Sunday ~10 AM).

Then save these as profile memories, update both routines' watchlist, location, sectors, and schedule, and tell them when the first digest arrives.

routines.name: Weekday layoffs & economy digest
routines.description: Fires weekday mornings to deliver new layoffs, WARN notices, and jobs data.
routines.content:
Build the owner's weekday layoffs and economy digest. (1) New US layoffs since the last digest from layoffs.fyi, reputable news (Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, TechCrunch), and WARN notices (especially the owner's state and California EDD), cross-checking WARN against WARNTracker (https://www.warntracker.com/) and Big Local News's WARN data (https://github.com/biglocalnews/warn-scraper): company, headcount, % of staff, sector, source link. Start with a WATCHLIST section for the owner's watched companies (say "no new news" if nothing). Then flag other big tech and employers near the owner's city; call out their priority sectors separately. (2) Economy data released since last digest: BLS Employment Situation (overall and by-industry unemployment, payrolls), DOL weekly jobless claims (Thursdays), JOLTS, Challenger job-cut report, the owner's state and metro unemployment. Show change vs prior period; say when something isn't released yet. Official or reputable sources only, verify links, never invent numbers. Short bullets. Deliver to the owner in this chat; if nothing new, one brief line. Never post or contact anyone else.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 10 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Sunday layoffs & jobs roundup
routines.description: Fires Sunday mornings to summarize the week's layoffs and sector unemployment trends.
routines.content:
Write the owner's weekly layoffs and jobs roundup. Start with a WATCHLIST section for the owner's watched companies (say "no new news" if nothing). Then the week's other biggest US layoffs (flag big tech and local employers; call out priority sectors), WARN highlights cross-checked against state lists plus WARNTracker (https://www.warntracker.com/) and Big Local News's WARN data (https://github.com/biglocalnews/warn-scraper), sector trends, jobless claims trend, and a small table of the latest BLS unemployment rate by industry with change vs prior month, plus the owner's state and metro rates. Official or reputable sources with verified links; never invent numbers; note data not yet released. Keep it short. Deliver to the owner in this chat. Never post or contact anyone else.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 10 * * 0`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
